name: Expand Energy
outlook:
What Expand Energy says to expect

  • Full year 2026: rigs, capital investment and productionFor the full year 2026, Expand Energy expects to run 11 – 12 rigs and has updated its capital investment guidance to approximately $3 billion. Average daily production is expected to be approximately 7.45 – 7.55 Bcfe/d.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 27, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
